title: The audit UI server is the same OS process as the dd MCP server -- restarting one kills the other
trigger: Before restarting the audit UI (e.g. after editing src/ui/server.js) to pick up a server-side route/logic change
behavior_delta: Check the actual process before killing it: on this setup the audit UI's listening port (e.g. 7733) is served by the same process running `node mcp.js`, not a separate UI-only process. Confirm via `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=<pid>' | select CommandLine` (Windows) or `ps -p <pid> -o command` before assuming a UI restart is low-blast-radius. Killing it also drops every mcp__dd__* tool for the current session until the harness respawns the MCP connection -- surface this tradeoff to the user before restarting, don't just restart silently.
what: Check the actual process before killing it: on this setup the audit UI's listening port (e.g. 7733) is served by the same process running `node mcp.js`, not a separate UI-only process. Confirm via `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=<pid>' | select CommandLine` (Windows) or `ps -p <pid> -o command` before assuming a UI restart is low-blast-radius. Killing it also drops every mcp__dd__* tool for the current session until the harness respawns the MCP connection -- surface this tradeoff to the user before restarting, don't just restart silently.
why: Verified live on 2026-09-19 while trying to restart the UI after editing src/ui/server.js to add auto_accept_threshold_levels to GET /api/config: netstat showed PID 28244 listening on 127.0.0.1:7733, and Get-CimInstance showed that PID's command line was `node mcp.js`, i.e. the same process the dd MCP tools run through in this session. User declined the restart specifically because of this shared-process tradeoff.

evidence_refs.source_ref: netstat -ano | grep :7733 -> PID 28244 LISTENING; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=28244' -> CommandLine: node mcp.js
evidence_refs.summary: Confirmed the audit UI's listening PID is the same process as the dd MCP server (node mcp.js), not a standalone UI server
